client_vein_miner.config.comment.main_to: Master switch for the whole mod.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.max_blo: Maximum number of blocks in a single chain.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.match_e:
If enabled, only blocks with the exact same block state are chained; 
if disabled, all blocks of the same type are chained (e.g. all log orientations).
client_vein_miner.config.comment.ignore_: Skip blocks with a block entity (chests, furnaces, etc.) so their contents are not lost.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.mining_:
The chain sends its own stop packet once the break progress reaches this percentage.
§670 is the lowest value the server accepts.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.creativ:
In single player the reach check is lifted completely.
In multiplayer §6via Servux§r the whole area is §ldeleted at once§r.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.mining_: Ticks to wait after finishing a block before starting the next one.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.auto_st:
Stops the chain after this many seconds without any mining progress. The countdown does not run while the hotkey is held.
0 = never stop automatically.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.reach_d:
How far (in blocks) a target may be from the player to count as reachable.
0 = use the vanilla block interaction range.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.require: If enabled, a target only counts as reachable when there is a clear line of sight to it.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.stop_on: If enabled, releasing the hotkey stops the chain.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.render_: Also draws the border lines on top of the filled target shapes.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.show_co: Shows the block count on screen.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.line_wi:
Width of the highlight lines.
§oUsed for both the preview group outline and the optional target borders
client_vein_miner.config.comment.highlig:
Opacity (in percent) of the red/green target fills.
§oThe preview outline is always opaque
client_vein_miner.config.comment.preview: Color of the group outline drawn while previewing.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.reachab: Color of the chain targets that are currently reachable.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.unreach: Color of the chain targets that are currently not reachable.
client_vein_miner.config.comment.block_b:
Block ids that should never be chained.
(e.g. minecraft:stone)
client_vein_miner.config.comment.hotkey_: Hold this hotkey while pointing at a block to preview the chain group.
Press to stop a running chain immediately.
